sql: with last_tick as (select distinct on (t.live_order_id) t.live_order_id, t.features_json f, t.contracts_ahead ahead from live_order_queue_ticks t join live_orders lo on lo.id=t.live_order_id where lo.strategy='Fmmsell10' and lo.status in ('filled','canceled') and lo.created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-16 11:00:00+00' order by t.live_order_id, t.captured_at desc), j as (select lo.status, (lt.f->>'qty_at_our_price')::float qty_our, (lt.f->>'qty_better')::float qty_better, lt.ahead from last_tick lt join live_orders lo on lo.id=lt.live_order_id) select '1_control_all' grp, count(*)::text n, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text fill_pct from j union all select '2_company_at_price_only (qty_our>0)', count(*)::text, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text from j where qty_our>0 union all select '3_no_better_competition_only (qty_better=0)', count(*)::text, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text from j where qty_better=0 union all select '4_STACKED (qty_our>0 AND qty_better=0)', count(*)::text, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text from j where qty_our>0 and qty_better=0 union all select '5_STACKED+front (qty_our>0 AND qty_better=0 AND ahead<=50)', count(*)::text, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text from j where qty_our>0 and qty_better=0 and ahead<=50 union all select '6_WORST (qty_our=0 AND qty_better>10)', count(*)::text, round(100.0*count(*) filter (where status='filled')/count(*))::text from j where qty_our=0 and qty_better>10 order by 1
